title: probe-tuning-and-autoscaler-stability-for-region-aware-failover
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Improve readiness/liveness probe behavior and autoscaler stability so multi-region failover and circuit-breaker driven load-shedding do not cause probe flapping or cascaded scale-downs that violate SLOs. Scope: 1) Introduce a two-tier probe model: fast liveness (process up) + weighted readiness (runtime health score) that considers KV cache warm fraction, GPU memory pressure, and recent error-rate windows. 2) Add hysteresis and probe-rate limiting to prevent rapid state flips during transient pressure. 3) Surface readiness score into autoscaler signals with smoothing and max-rate-of-scale to avoid reactionary scaling. 4) Integrate readiness with circuit-breaker so a node in temporary degraded readiness can be quarantined for low-risk traffic rather than removed from service immediately. Success criteria: reduce probe-related instance churn by >= 70% in canary region, eliminate cascading autoscaler scale-down events that cause p99 latency SLO violations during traffic drops, and maintain error-rate below 0.5% under defined burst tests.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after post-mortem for incident on 2025-02-08 where autoscaler over-reacted to probe failures, causing multiregion failover flapping.

2025-02-12 - Marco Liu: Drafted design doc; proposing runtime health score computed as weighted sum: 40% KV cache warm fraction, 30% tail latency window, 20% error rate, 10% GPU mem pressure. Shortlist threshold values for review.

2025-02-16 - Design review (SRE + Runtime): Agreed on two-tier probes and hysteresis. Concerns: how to avoid masking legitimate node failures. Action: implement fail-open path for liveness and fail-closed for readiness after multiple consecutive failed checks.
2025-02-20 - Load test (canary infra): Ran 30m burst test with current probes; observed 4 probe flips per minute during ramp-down, leading to scale-down thrash. Baseline attached in links.
2025-02-24 - Marco Liu: Implemented probe-rate limiting and exponential-backoff on readiness transitions (PR opened). Added autoscaler smoothing: 60s moving average and max 20% scale change per 3m.
2025-02-26 - PR feedback from SRE (J. Kim): Request to expose health-score metrics to Grafana and add alert if readiness gating causes node quarantining above 5% of fleet.

2025-03-01 - Load tests v2: With hysteresis and autoscaler smoothing, probe flips reduced by ~78% in canary region; scale events reduced and p99 latency stayed within SLO. Noted elevated warmup time for cold starts impacting readiness score; added short-circuit for known cold-start paths.

2025-03-03 - PM review (T. Nguyen): Approved canary rollout for 2 regions. PM requested linkage to rollout playbook and rollback criteria. Action: add console dashboard and automated rollback if quarantine > 15% or p99 > SLO for 5m.

2025-03-04 - Marco Liu: Preparing canary rollout plan and documentation. Need final approval for release runtime-1.20. Assigned follow-ups: add e2e test for circuit-breaker interaction and update runbook.
